top_jobs.job: When organic revenue falls 20 percent in a week and no one knows why, help me see within a day which pages and search terms lost it, and what organic really earns from our own orders, so I fix it before a month of sales is gone
top_jobs.metric: organic revenue from store orders, week on week

top_jobs.job: When money pages sit at position 8 to 20 or guides lose half their clicks, help me fix the pages Google already trusts before writing new ones, so I get the fastest organic growth for the least work
top_jobs.metric: clicks to money pages from Search Console

top_jobs.job: When buyers search for things we sell and we have no page for them, help me write pages and articles from what they type, ask, buy on our ads and say in reviews, so I catch buyers early with pages that sell
top_jobs.metric: new pages in the top 10 and orders from them

top_jobs.job: When a developer ships a change, a new app goes in or we move themes, help me catch anything that blocks Google or breaks pages the same day, so I do not lose years of search traffic in a week
top_jobs.metric: money pages indexed and serving with price and stars

jobs.job: Connect Search Console and an SEO data source such as OpenSEO through the MCP, and pull queries, pages, positions and clicks every day into one table

inputs.need: Search Console queries and pages, 16 months
an SEO data source for volumes, rival ranks and links, such as OpenSEO
keyword universe with intent and priority
organic landing page sessions and orders

steps: Connect Search Console and the SEO source through the MCP, read only
Pull 16 months of queries and pages as the baseline
Tag each query brand or non-brand and by intent
Join pages to GA4 organic sessions and orders
Check 10 rows by hand against the Search Console screen
jobs.output: a daily table of query, page, position, clicks, impressions and orders
jobs.next: feeds every job on this screen and 18-02

jobs.job: Tie organic to store orders each month: sessions, orders, revenue and new customers by landing page, non-brand apart from brand

inputs.need: organic sessions and orders by landing page
orders with UTM and new vs returning

steps: Pull organic sessions and orders by landing page for the month
Check GA4 organic orders against Shopify's organic count and note the gap
Split brand queries from non-brand by landing page
Rank the 20 pages that earn the most non-brand revenue
Write the 2 minute summary: grew or not, from which pages, what needs the founder
jobs.output: a 2 minute monthly card with organic revenue, new customers and the top 20 pages

jobs.job: Find the cause of a 20 percent organic drop within a day: which pages and terms lost clicks, and whether it was ranking, click rate, demand, tracking or indexing
jobs.trigger: when organic revenue or clicks drop 20 percent week on week

inputs.need: daily clicks, impressions and positions per page

steps: Compare the last 7 days with the 7 before per page
Sort the loss into: lower rank, lower click rate, lower demand, tracking break or pages dropped from the index
Check the change log and update dates for the same days
Name the 5 pages with the most revenue lost and the cause for each
Write the fix and the owner, and recheck in 7 days
jobs.output: a 1 page cause note with 5 pages, the cause of each and the fix

jobs.job: Check an SEO agency report or a link building pitch against our own clicks, orders and past results before paying
jobs.trigger: monthly, and each time someone pitches
steps: List every claim in the report or pitch
Check each against our own clicks and orders for the pages named
Mark true, false or cannot tell
Write 5 questions the founder should ask
Log the verdict in the agency history
jobs.output: a claim check with true, false or cannot tell on each line, and 5 questions
jobs.drives: money spent only on work that moves sales

jobs.job: List money pages at position 8 to 20 with the most impressions and write the fix for each: title, internal links and the content the top 3 have and we lack

inputs.need: pages with position and impressions per query
top 3 results for each target term

steps: Pull pages at position 8 to 20 with over 500 impressions a month
Rank by impressions times conversion rate
For the top 10, read the top 3 results and list what they have that we lack
Write the fix: title, 3 internal links from strong pages, missing blocks
Ship 5 fixes and read positions at 4 weeks
jobs.output: 10 pages with a written fix, 5 shipped, with a read date

jobs.job: Rewrite titles and meta descriptions of 20 pages with high impressions and low click rate, using the words that win in Google Ads and Meta hooks

inputs.need: pages with impressions, clicks and position
Google Ads headlines and search terms that convert
Meta hooks with the best click rate

steps: List 20 pages in the top 10 with click rate below the norm for their position
Pull the paid headlines and hooks that win for the same topic
Write a new title and description led by the buyer's term and the winning angle
A person checks each is true and fits the page
Ship and read click rate at 4 weeks
jobs.output: 20 new titles and descriptions, each linked to the paid ad or hook it borrows from
jobs.drives: more clicks without a rank change

jobs.job: Refresh the 10 guides that lost half their clicks: new facts, current products, the questions now asked, and a check for AI answers on top

inputs.need: clicks per page, this year vs last
results page view per target term

steps: List guides with clicks down 50 percent year on year
Check each: lost rank, lost to an AI answer, or lost demand
Skip pages lost to demand; refresh the rest
Update facts and products, add 3 new questions, add a product block
Read clicks at 6 weeks
jobs.output: 10 refreshed guides with the cause of loss noted on each

jobs.job: Check each money page answers what its searchers wanted, compared with the top 3 results, and add the missing blocks such as size chart, comparison and FAQ
jobs.trigger: each quarter, and when a page ranks but does not sell

inputs.need: queries per page with conversion rate

steps: List pages with good rank and low conversion
Read the queries that bring buyers to each
Compare the page with the top 3 results for the lead query
Add the missing blocks with true answers
Read conversion rate at 4 weeks
jobs.output: a list of pages with the blocks added and a read date

watch.metric: conversion rate of organic visits to the pages

jobs.job: List 20 sites that link to 2 rivals and not to us, and pitch the 5 our buyers read with a real reason

inputs.need: stories and data we can offer

steps: Pull sites linking to 2 or more rivals and not us
Drop spam and paid link farms
Pick the 5 our buyers read
Write a pitch per site with a real reason: data, a story, a sample
Log replies and links won
jobs.output: 5 pitches sent and a list of 20 target sites

jobs.job: Build 10 article briefs from 4 sources: Search Console gaps, Google Ads terms that sell, Meta's winning angles, and review and ticket questions

inputs.need: queries with impressions and no good page
Google Ads search terms with purchases

steps: Pull queries with 200 or more impressions and no page in the top 20
Match each to a paid search term that sells and a Meta angle that wins
Add the review and ticket words buyers use for the same problem
Write 10 briefs: the question, the angle, the proof, the product link
Founder picks 4 to write this month
jobs.output: 10 briefs, each with its 4 sources named, 4 picked to write

watch.metric: impressions and orders from the new articles

jobs.job: Pick FAQ and article work from the question coverage matrix: the blank cells asked most become answer blocks on product pages or full articles
steps: Sort blank cells by how often each question is asked
Short answers go on the product page FAQ; long ones become articles
Write the top 10 with facts from the products shelf
Mark each matrix cell filled with the page URL
Read tickets and conversion on those products at 4 weeks
jobs.output: 10 answers live and the matrix updated with URLs

jobs.job: Write 5 'best X for Y' and 'X vs Y' guides that lead to a product, with an honest comparison

inputs.need: rival reviews: where they win and fail

steps: Pick 5 comparison or 'best' terms with volume and buying intent
Read the top 3 results for each
Write each guide with a fair table, who each option is for, and our product where it truly fits
A person checks every claim about a rival is true and dated
Link each guide to the product and read orders at 90 days
jobs.output: 5 published guides with a checked comparison table

jobs.job: Rename product and collection page titles in the words buyers type, keeping our brand name after
jobs.trigger: once, then when a product launches

inputs.need: queries that reach each product page
Google Ads and Amazon terms that sell

steps: List pages whose title uses a name no one searches
Pull the terms buyers use for that product
Write title and H1 as the buyer's term, then our name
Founder approves name changes
Read impressions at 4 weeks
jobs.output: renamed titles and H1s for product and collection pages
jobs.drives: pages found by the words buyers use

jobs.job: Pull category search demand quarter by quarter for 3 years, compare it with our organic growth, and list the 10 terms rising fastest

inputs.need: search volume by month for 50 category terms
our organic clicks and orders by quarter

steps: Pull 3 years of volume for the category terms
Sum by quarter and compute year on year change
Put our organic clicks and orders next to it
Write whether we grew faster or slower than the category
List the 10 rising terms and whether we have a page for each
jobs.output: a quarter by quarter chart of category vs us, and 10 rising terms
jobs.drives: budget set on the real trend

jobs.job: Get seasonal pages live and refreshed 8 weeks before each season, with links from the home page
jobs.trigger: 8 weeks before each season on the calendar

inputs.need: seasonal terms and last year's clicks by week

steps: List last year's seasonal pages and their clicks by week
Refresh each with this year's products and offers
Build any missing page for a rising seasonal term
Link them from the home page and top collections
Check indexing 2 weeks later
jobs.output: seasonal pages live and indexed 6 weeks before the season

watch.metric: clicks to seasonal pages vs last year

jobs.job: Send search winners back to paid: articles and queries that bring orders become Google ad groups and Meta hooks

inputs.need: queries and articles with organic orders

steps: List the 10 queries and 5 articles with the most organic orders
Check which have no Google ad group and add them
Turn each article's lead angle into 2 Meta hooks
Hand both lists to the paid team
Read results next month
jobs.output: a list of new ad groups and hooks, each tied to an organic winner

watch.metric: orders from new ad groups and hooks

jobs.drives: paid ads built on proven words

jobs.job: Check every theme change, app install and deploy the same day for noindex, robots blocks, broken canonicals, schema errors and redirects
steps: Crawl the money pages after the change
Compare with the last good crawl
Flag any new noindex, blocked page, wrong canonical, schema error or redirect chain
Send the fix to the person who shipped the change
Recrawl after the fix
jobs.output: a same-day crawl diff with fixes sent

jobs.job: Map every ranking URL before a theme or platform move, set 301s, and check each one works the day after launch

inputs.need: all URLs with clicks in 16 months

steps: Export every URL with clicks or links
Map each to its new URL, one to one
Load the redirects on staging and crawl them
Launch, then crawl every old URL the next day
Watch clicks daily for 4 weeks
jobs.output: a signed URL map and a day-after check with every redirect passing

watch.metric: organic clicks vs the week before launch

jobs.job: Keep sold out and discontinued pages earning: waitlist and similar products for gaps, a 301 to the nearest product for discontinued ones
jobs.trigger: when a ranking product goes out of stock for 14 days or is discontinued
steps: List out of stock or discontinued pages with clicks
For short gaps, add a waitlist and 3 similar products
For discontinued, 301 to the nearest product
Never delete a page with clicks
Check waitlist sign-ups and redirected orders monthly
jobs.output: a list of pages with the action on each

jobs.job: Keep stars, prices and stock showing in search: check product schema and free listings weekly and fix pages that broke

inputs.need: rich result and merchant listing reports

steps: Pull rich result errors and warnings
Match each to a template or app
Fix at the template so all pages heal
Validate 5 pages by hand
Recheck the next week
jobs.output: a weekly schema check with template fixes

watch.metric: pages with valid product rich results

new_enablers.name: Crawl watch
new_enablers.what: Crawls the money pages daily and after every theme change, app install or deploy. Checks robots rules, noindex, canonicals, redirects, status codes, product schema (price, stock, stars) and content in the first HTML. Keeps a URL map for migrations.
inputs: the deploy and app change log
powers: same-day alerts when a change blocks Google
stars and prices kept in results
